why: भवनानि 'houses' fits: Hanuman passes all their mansions, then reaches Ravana's residence.
वदनानि 'faces' of the sleeping women, lotus-scented; sense and metre fine.
निगच्छति 'goes down to hell' is a regular form; metre fine.
वैदिशम् is the city Vidisha given to Shatrughna's son; a name.
राजासनं 'royal seat' which the king leaves to meet Vasishtha; correct.
सुबहवो 'very many' monkeys; valid form, metre fine.
वश्चिरम् = वः चिरम् 'what use is your long prattle'; good sandhi and sense.
सुव्रतम् describes Ushanas chosen as priest; fine.
स्मर्तुमर्हसि 'you should remember' the tilaka episode; correct.
प्रददौ च विभूषणम् 'gave an ornament' to Vidyujjihva; fits the context.
सविभीषणम् 'together with Vibhishana' agrees with सौमित्रिं; fine.
महानूपाः = महा-अनूपाः 'great marshlands' alongside rivers and mountains; correct.
शीलवान् 'of good character' describing Lakshmana; fine.
शुभाशुभे 'good and bad' object of विजानन्ति; correct.
मालवान् is the people Malava in a list of regions; a name.
धरिष्यति 'will hold out a month'; fits sense.
महाद्विपाः 'great elephants' chased by lions; correct simile.
सुबलवान् 'very strong' adharma; valid.
चरिष्यति कथा 'the story will go about the worlds'; fine.
महातेज is vocative महातेजः with visarga lost before आश्रमं; correct sandhi.
अथाभिवाद्य = अथ अभिवाद्य; normal.
महागज इवारण्ये continues the elephant simile of the previous line; correct.
समारुताः 'with winds' in a list of winter-day epithets; fine.
स्रम् is no root; स्मरिष्यसि 'you will not remember human women' is the form, metre unchanged.
माहात्मानो is not a word; the nominative plural is महात्मानो.
सुदारुणाम् agrees with feminine अवस्थां; correct.
सानुमान् 'mountain' in the simile 'like a mountain grown over'; correct.
महाभुज vocative 'mighty-armed'; fine.
सुमहात्मानो 'the very great-souled ones'; valid, metre fine.
प्रविहाय हर्षम् 'abandoning joy' fits; the split सर्वेऽप्य्॑ अश्रूणि is only the pada marker inside sandhi.
क्षमिष्यति 'will not forgive' fits Sugriva's harsh nature; correct.
प्रकुरुते मनः 'sets his mind on dharma'; fine.
नागमिष्यति = न आगमिष्यति 'no trouble will come to you'; correct.
सुमहाद्युतिः a normal epithet; metre fine.
कृता मम महाप्रीतिः 'you have given me great joy'; correct.
स्वबलेन 'with his own army' Malyavan returns to Lanka; fine.
महाधृतिः 'of great firmness' describing the sage Pulastya; valid.
क्रमिष्यति 'who else will stride (carrying me)'; fits the context of Hanuman's strength.
स्वधर्मेण 'by one's own dharma'; fine.
रामस्यास्तु parallels भरतस्यास्तु in the same line; correct.
समहर्षयः 'together with the great sages'; fine.
त्रिलोकानां 'of the three worlds'; correct.
हतयूथपाः 'whose troop-leaders were slain', parallel to हतबान्धवाः before; correct.
भूषितानां 'adorned' rakshasas whose radiance is seen; fine.
ज्याशब्देन 'with the bowstring sound'; correct.
तच्छिरसा = तत् शिरसा 'accepting that word with his head'; good sandhi.
अथायोध्यां = अथ अयोध्यां; normal.
जीविष्यन्ति 'will live (to see Rama return)'; fits the next line.
भजिष्यन्ति 'will serve' Angada installed on the throne; correct.
हनुमतः with short u is a valid form the epic uses beside हनूमतः; metre fine.
गर्हितम् 'censured by worldly conduct'; correct.
हनूमातः is no form and the extra long syllable breaks the upendravajra pada; हनूमतः is needed.
निर्दहतो 'of (fire) burning the forest'; fits the simile of radiance.
यथाप्रियं 'as you please' in a line playing on प्रिय; fine.
प्रभविष्यन्ति 'will not prevail over'; correct.
स्वभवनं 'to their own abode'; fine.
सर्वास्त्राणि 'all the weapons', sons of Krishashva; correct.
यशस्विनाम् 'of the renowned brahmins', masculine genitive plural; correct.
महामुखम् 'great-mouthed' Kabandha with big fangs; correct.
अतोऽहं 'therefore I' is fine; the space in कृच्छ्र गतो is only word spacing, the letters are right.
